accommodation: 20 en-suite rooms, most with sea views, including family rooms, dog-friendly rooms and suites
suitableFor: Couples, families, dog owners and walkers
parking: Private parking for suite guests; others use the two public car parks in Lynmouth, a short walk away
dogs: Allowed in dog-friendly rooms and the Galley area
confirmedFeatures: Dining room serving breakfast and evening meals, adjoining Ancient Mariner bar and restaurant with harbour-view decking, weddings
overview: A Victorian hotel overlooking Lynmouth harbour, run by the same family since 1951, with 20 individually decorated en-suite rooms. It is a few minutes from the South West Coast Path and the cliff railway up to Lynton.
surfTripFit: Handy for surfing at Lynmouth's river-mouth break when it works, but the hotel says nothing about surf facilities and the main North Devon beaches are a drive away.
gaps: No beach or surf information; board storage not stated.
